name: The Sheffield Wednesday Lot

name: The Thrillbillies
caption: MBE's own tag team champions through its 2007 relaunch, a pair of South Carolina wrestlers who have never lost the belts.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap of "The New Neighbors Have a Hot Tub" (20 July 2007), served this pass

identity.note: A bare-name collision with a held redneck-duo tag team at a different federation, whose own members are recorded unnamed. No document read this pass connects the two, and the name is a common enough archetype pairing ("Thrillbillies") for independent reuse; filed distinct rather than merged.
